description: Ernakulam launches AI-ERA, aiming to make it Kerala's first AI-literate government district. This initiative will train officials, enhance public
body_lead: AI-ERA project to make Ernakulam Kerala's first AI-literate govt district The Ernakulam district administration, in association with the Kerala State IT Mission, is launching AI-ERA (Ernakulam Revolutionising Administration), an initiative aimed at transforming Ernakulam into Kerala's first AI-literate government district. AI-ERA seeks to equip government officials with foundational knowledge and practical skills in Artificial Intelligence (AI), while promoting the responsible, secure and effective use of the technology in public administration.
